title: The next meeting was held at Bishkek State University

blocks.text: On April 8, 2025, the next meeting of deans and heads of departments was held at Bishkek State University named after K. Karasayev. During the event, important issues on the agenda were considered. In particular, appropriate decisions were made on the development of a new official website of the university. Also, Rector Mirlan Dyldaev introduced the new coordinator for international relations to the staff - Rakhat Rai kyzy. On behalf of the Rector, Dean of the Faculty of Ecology and Management Elegiya Bokoeva, as well as Dean of the Faculty of Social and Psychological Sciences Perizat Aitbaeva presented strategic plans for the development of their faculties for 2025-2030. In conclusion, recommendations were given on the implementation of the tasks and strategic plans.
